watch.summary: A streamer questions his life choices and reacts in utter disbelief to a pro Valorant play.

beats.what: Streamer complains about flashes and says he should work as an accountant instead.
Asuna uses a flash and moves out into the open in the pro match clip.
Streamer puts his hand on his head in utter confusion.
Streamer realizes Asuna pushed out just to grab an orb and calls it out in disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I should work as an accountant instead.
watch.why: The streamer's dramatic tangent about switching careers to accounting contrasts hilariously with his genuine disbelief at the pro player's risky play. It delivers good expressive comedy, though understanding the match context heightens the joke.
